name: Message accepted connections (Supabase)
description: Reads pending rows from Supabase connection_requests (Chrome extension capture), sends a LinkedIn DM when Message is available, then deletes the row on successful send. Default dry-run.

env.name: CONNECTION_FOLLOWUP_DRY_RUN
env.description: When true, type the DM but do not click Send or delete from Supabase

env.name: CONNECTION_FOLLOWUP_MAX
env.description: Max pending Supabase rows to process this run

env.name: CONNECTION_FOLLOWUP_ONLY_ACCEPTED
env.description: When true, skip profiles still pending (Connect not yet accepted)

env.name: CONNECTION_FOLLOWUP_SERVICE
env.description: Service label used in follow-up message templates

env.name: SUPABASE_URL
env.description: Supabase project URL (same as extension VITE_SUPABASE_URL)

env.name: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
env.description: Publishable/anon key for SELECT (same as extension)

env.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
env.description: Secret key for DELETE after live send — required for --no-dry-run
